mentions.name: Django+Celery DigitalOcean deploy script
mentions.description: A script that deploys Django+Celery projects to a DigitalOcean droplet. After configuring a few variables such as the server IP, it produces a complete deployment for a side project and can be re-run to deploy new versions.
mentions.problem: Deploying Django+Celery projects to DigitalOcean previously felt daunting to the author.
mentions.source_excerpt: I did (with the help of GPT) a simple script to deploy my Django+Celery projects to DigitalOcean. I was a bit afraid of that in the past, but now it's just a script that, after configuring a few variables (IP, etc), runs smoothly and gives me a perfectly deploy for a side project on a DO droplet. And also I can run again to just deploy a new version.
